gap: No result ChatGPT got says that the foot pedal on each cheap AC/DC TIG welder only works with that brand's own machines. LOTOS sells its FP05P pedal as fitting only the brown TIG200ACDCP and 'NOT Compatible with any other Brand'. The PrimeWeld TIG225X needs PrimeWeld's own 7-pin pedal at $125, because the 5-pin $69 PrimeWeld pedal is for the CT520D only. ARCCAPTAIN's $79.99 5-pin pedal works on the TIG200, the TIG200P AC/DC and the TIG205 Pro, so a beginner who buys the DC TIG200 with a pedal can keep that pedal when moving up to the AC/DC model for aluminum.
standout_why: I read the two pages ChatGPT cited. homewelder.com says only that YesWelder's pedal variant 'includes the 5-pin pedal' and that the AHP pedal is a Nova. It gives no pin count or exclusions for LOTOS, PrimeWeld or ARCCAPTAIN, and says nothing about which brands' pedals fit which machines. woodworking-projects.com/hobby-tig-welder gives no pedal connector details at all. It only notes a 'CK-style torch' for the TIG225X and says 'no foot pedal on the base version' for the TIG-205DS. ChatGPT's own answer only said to verify pedal compatibility for the SSimder. For the LOTOS, YesWelder, AHP and PrimeWeld picks it gave just 'check whether the foot pedal is included'.
decides: This shapes the pick rather than deciding it outright. The LOTOS TIG200ACDC at $399.98 comes with its pedal and argon regulator, so its no-other-brand pedal limit doesn't matter to the buyer. That keeps it the cheapest complete AC/DC kit. The YesWelder TIG-200P and ARCCAPTAIN TIG200P AC/DC ship without a pedal in the base listing, so the right comparison is pedal-included kit against pedal-included kit: YesWelder's pedal variant at $599.15 against ARCCAPTAIN's pedal kit at $729.99. Our page already lists the ARCCAPTAIN TIG200 DC with a $79.99 pedal. The maker says that same pedal works on the TIG200P AC/DC, so the page can honestly offer the DC TIG200 as a cheap start with an upgrade to aluminum later that keeps the pedal. On 110V, the maker pages give TIG output of 10–140A for the YesWelder TIG-200P and 10–120A for the ARCCAPTAIN TIG200P. Full 200A needs 220V on both.

findings.label: In the box and price
findings.value: $399.98 (compare-at $549.98). Package includes the power supply, TIG torch, MMA/stick clamp, foot pedal, argon regulator, 220V/110V converter pigtail, ground clamp and consumable set. Input: automatic dual voltage, 110/120 V and 220/240 V. Warranty: 1-year new replacement, 3-year limited total.
findings.source_title: LOTOS TIG200ACDC 200A AC/DC Aluminum TIG Welder ... with Foot Pedal and Argon Regulator 110/220V Dual Voltage Brown
findings.note: Read from LOTOS's Shopify store data (uwelding.com, the LOTOS Technology store) with storecheck search. A direct fetch of the page returned HTTP 429. The price matches ChatGPT's $399.98 card.

findings.label: Pedal exclusion
findings.value: The FP05P pedal ($89) is 'Only Compatible with BROWN Color Lotos TIG200ACDCP TIG Welder with Pulse', is 'NOT Compatible with Red or Brown Color Lotos TIG200, TIG200DC', and is 'NOT Compatible with any other Brand and any other Model of TIG Welder'. 16 ft cable. The TIG200ACDCP ($449.98) ships with no foot pedal and no argon regulator.
findings.source_title: LOTOS FP05P for Lotos TIG200ACDCP TIG welder
findings.note: Quoted from the maker's store listing (storecheck). The fact that the TIG200ACDCP excludes the pedal and regulator comes from https://uwelding.com/products/tig200acdcp, read the same day.

findings.label: Tungsten kit type
findings.value: The LOTOS DTE10 kit is 10 pieces of 2% thoriated tungsten 'designed specifically for DC TIG welding' on steel. It is listed for the TIG200 and TIG200ACDCP. It is marked out of stock.
findings.source_title: LOTOS DTE10 For TIG200 Tungsten TIG Welding Electrodes 10pc
findings.note: The maker's own spare-tungsten kit for these machines is listed for DC steel welding only. An aluminum beginner needs a separate tungsten suitable for AC.

findings.label: Pedal model, torch, 110V limit, variant prices
findings.value: Base $649.00 with no pedal. The '& Foot Pedal' variant is $599.15 and adds the FP-5P-B 5-pin pedal. Torch: WP-26 with an M16×1.5 connector, 5-pin control cable, 13 ft. TIG output 10–140A at 110V (60% duty at 140A) and 10–200A at 220V (30% duty at 200A). A 220V-to-110V adapter is listed as included. 2-year warranty.
findings.note: Variant prices are as shown on the maker page today. The pedal variant really is listed below the base price. The page's own label for pedal compatibility says only 'Supported' and names no third-party pedals.

findings.product: ARCCAPTAIN TIG200 / TIG200P AC/DC / TIG205 Pro
findings.label: Shared pedal
findings.value: The 10 ft remote amp control pedal is $79.99. It has a 5-pin (2+3) connector and a 0–200 A range. The maker's compatibility table says: TIG200 Yes, TIG200P AC/DC Yes, TIG205 Pro Yes, MIG205MP No.
findings.source_title: 10 Ft Cable Remote Amp Control TIG Welder Foot Pedal
findings.note: From the maker store via storecheck. This is the same $79.99 pedal our current page pairs with the ARCCAPTAIN TIG200.

findings.label: Price, pedal, 110V output
findings.value: $649.99 for the welder with the 'foot pedal (sold separately)'. The Foot Pedal Kit is $729.99 (compare-at $989.99). TIG output is 10–120 A on 110 V. The kit page says '220V provides the machine's full rated TIG output.' The torch is a WP-26.

findings.note: Store data via storecheck. The kit price and the 220V quote come from https://www.arccaptain.com/products/tig200p-ac-dc-tig-welder-foot-pedal-kit, read the same day.

findings.value: The TIG225X pedal is $125 with a 25 ft cable, and its store URL names it '7-pin'. PrimeWeld's 5-pin pedal ($69) is 'for the PrimeWeld Multi-Process Series: CT520D ... CT520DP'. That page sends TIG225X owners to the separate pedal. The AirLink wireless pedal is $295 and is listed for the TIG225X and TIG325X.
